author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

Restore skipping `MPI_Finalize()` on failures.
An exception thrown while constructing the `EventProcessor` does not trigger any early termination signal, so the `MPIService` does not call `MPI_Abort()`.
Calling `MPI_Finalize()` from its destructor then blocks waiting for the other processes, which may be blocked waiting for this one (e.g. the `MPISource` waiting for the `MPIController`'s initial connection), and the original error is never reported.

Fix the MPI transient product test configurations.

Give the MPI tests unique names: two unit tests were named `testMPIAutosplitter`. Rename the one that runs `testAutomaticSplitterMultiProcess.sh` to `testMPIAutosplitterMultiProcess`.

#### PR validation:

Tests pass.
title: Fix recent MPI test issues
